title: SKE Crystal 2400 4in1 Watermelon Ice Pre-Filled Vape Pods 20mg - 4 x Pods
description: Refresh your senses with the cool, juicy taste of Watermelon Ice in these SKE Crystal 4in1 prefilled pods. Each pod encapsulates the sweet, refreshing taste of luscious watermelon with a chilly twist, perfect for a smooth and uplifting MTL vaping experience. Enhanced with Nic-Salt vape juice, these pods offer a delicious vaping experience. The SKE Crystal 4in1 Vape Pods replicate the popular flavours of SKE Crystal Disposable Vapes in a more cost-effective and eco-friendly format. Designed for the SKE Crystal 4in1 Prefilled Pod Kits, these easy-to-use pods fit seamlessly into the device's rotating mechanism, allowing you to enjoy four flavours in one handy vape kit.
